title: 都在吹小鹏二代VLA，它到底厉害在哪？
title_en: Why Is Everyone Raving About XPeng's Gen-2 VLA?
eyebrow: AI & Autonomous Driving · AI 与智能驾驶
summary_cn: 三刀拆解小鹏第二代VLA物理世界大模型：从VLA 1.0「看懂」到2.0「洞察」的代际跃迁，对比华为/英伟达/理想/元戎启行四条技术路线，以及可解释性如何重建公众对智驾的信任
summary_en: This episode takes three deep cuts at XPeng's second-generation VLA world model: the generational leap from VLA 1.0 'understanding what you see' to 2.0 'insight'; a comparison of four tech routes from Huawei, Nvidia, Li Auto, and Yuanrong Qixing; and how interpretability rebuilds public trust in autonomous driving. The core argument: sensing isn't understanding, and action isn't reasoning — the real question is whether the car can predict intent and explain itself in human language.

scenes.title_cn: 一、VLA是什么：从「看到」到「看懂」再到「洞察」
scenes.title_en: What Is VLA? From 'Seeing' to 'Understanding' to 'Insight'
scenes.context: VLA 模型的定义、各家实现差异与智驾进化三阶段。语域：casual 技术科普 + formal 架构分析。
scenes.speak: The core mechanism: a Vision-Language-Action model — it first 'sees' the road, uses 'language' to describe and understand it, then 'executes' the driving action, fusing perception, reasoning, and decision-making into one. The key insight: nearly every on-device end-to-end autonomous driving campaign slaps on a VLA label, but the depth of implementation varies wildly. Cars with lidar use fused perception; cars without lidar go pure vision — at the core, everything is vision-based. A typical scene: complex intersection games, unmarked roads, construction detours — open scenarios with no standard answer, 'semi-open questions.' As the episode put it: sensing doesn't equal understanding — just seeing something doesn't mean you understand it; and action doesn't equal reasoning — a pure reflex is a hard shot, not thinking. Related concept: end-to-end doesn't equal VLA; VLA is an advanced form of end-to-end with an added language reasoning layer. The three stages: stage one, rule hard-coding — like memorizing a dictionary; if the question isn't in the bank, the car freezes. Stage two, data imitation — like a small-town test grinder; aced the drills, but trip over any question that bends the format. Stage three, VLA 1.0 — it starts to understand the question: looking at the scene, trying to answer 'why am I turning the wheel this way, and tapping this brake?'

sentences.cn: 核心机制：视觉语言行动模型——先「看到」路况，用「语言」描述理解，再「执行」驾驶动作。把感知、推理、决策融为一体
sentences.en: The core mechanism: a Vision-Language-Action model — it first 'sees' the road, uses 'language' to describe and understand it, then 'executes' the driving action, fusing perception, reasoning, and decision-making into one.
sentences.note: 表达提示VLA（Vision-Language-Action）→ 视觉语言行动模型；fuse into one → 融为一体；perception → 感知

sentences.cn: 关键理解：端侧端到端智驾宣传几乎都挂VLA标签，但各家的实现深度天差地别。有激光雷达走融合感知，无激光雷达走纯视觉，本质都是视觉为基础
sentences.en: The key insight: nearly every on-device end-to-end autonomous driving campaign slaps on a VLA label, but the depth of implementation varies wildly. Cars with lidar use fused perception; cars without lidar go pure vision — at the core, everything is vision-based.
sentences.note: 表达提示on-device → 端侧；end-to-end → 端到端；lidar → 激光雷达

sentences.cn: 典型场景：复杂路口博弈、无标线道路、施工改道等开放场景——没有标准答案的「半开放题」
sentences.en: A typical scene: complex intersection games, unmarked roads, construction detours — open scenarios with no standard answer, 'semi-open questions.'
sentences.note: 表达提示intersection game → 路口博弈；unmarked road → 无标线道路；semi-open question → 半开放题

sentences.cn: （引用）原文依据：「感知不等于理解，只是看到了不能看懂；动作不等于推理，只会条件反射硬射，不会去思考。」
sentences.en: As the episode put it: 'Sensing doesn't equal understanding — just seeing something doesn't mean you understand it. And action doesn't equal reasoning — a pure reflex is a hard shot, not thinking.'
sentences.note: 表达提示sensing ≠ understanding → 感知≠理解；conditioned reflex → 条件反射；hard shot → 硬射

sentences.cn: （引用）相关概念：端到端 ≠ VLA；VLA是端到端的一种高级形态，增加了语言推理层
sentences.en: Related concept: end-to-end doesn't equal VLA; VLA is an advanced form of end-to-end with an added language reasoning layer.
sentences.note: 表达提示advanced form → 高级形态；language reasoning layer → 语言推理层

sentences.cn: 第一阶段：规则硬编码——像背字典，题库没有的题就愣住。 第二阶段：数据模仿——像小镇做题家，刷题多但题目改个弯就翻车。 第三阶段（VLA 1.0）：开始理解题意——看到画面，尝试回答「我为什么要这么打方向、踩这一脚刹车」
sentences.en: Stage one, rule hard-coding — like memorizing a dictionary; if the question isn't in the bank, the car freezes. Stage two, data imitation — like a small-town test grinder; aced the drills, but trip over any question that bends the format. Stage three, VLA 1.0 — it starts to understand the question: looking at the scene, trying to answer 'why am I turning the wheel this way, and tapping this brake?'
sentences.note: 表达提示hard-coding → 硬编码；test grinder → 刷题机器/小镇做题家；turn the wheel → 打方向

Seeing something doesn't mean you get it.

scenes.title_cn: 二、一代 vs 二代：从「看懂」到「洞察」
scenes.context: 一代的场景到动作映射与二代的意图理解与风险预判。语域：formal 技术对比分析。
scenes.speak: Gen one, the core mechanism: it recognizes intersections, pedestrians, and construction cones, and knows to slow down and yield. It evolved from 'memorizing questions' to 'reading questions,' but its understanding isn't deep — no anticipation. The key insight: a scene-to-action mapping, essentially 'I've seen something like this, so I roughly know what to do' — experience-driven. The boundary: common scenarios work well, but brand-new game situations easily cause hesitation or mistakes. As the episode put it: gen one mostly maps scenes to actions; gen two has started to understand the scene-to-intent process, then runs an action simulation. Gen two, the core mechanism: not just recognizing 'is this an intersection?' but judging 'is this pedestrian crossing or waiting?' 'will that scooter cut across next second?' — predicting intent and risk. The key insight: world-model-driven. Even without seeing an identical scene, it can infer what will happen next based on the current environment and drive defensively in advance.

sentences.cn: 核心机制：能识别路口、行人、施工锥桶，知道该减速让行。从「背题」进化到「会读题」，但理解还不够深，不会预判
sentences.en: The core mechanism: it recognizes intersections, pedestrians, and construction cones, and knows to slow down and yield. It evolved from 'memorizing questions' to 'reading questions,' but its understanding isn't deep — no anticipation.
sentences.note: 表达提示slow down and yield → 减速让行；memorize → 背题；anticipation → 预判

sentences.cn: 关键理解：场景→动作的映射，本质是「我见过类似的，所以我知道大概怎么办」——经验驱动
sentences.en: The key insight: a scene-to-action mapping, essentially 'I've seen something like this, so I roughly know what to do' — experience-driven.
sentences.note: 表达提示mapping → 映射；experience-driven → 经验驱动；roughly know → 大概知道

sentences.cn: 适用边界：常见场景表现不错，但遇到全新博弈局面容易犹豫或犯错
sentences.en: The boundary: common scenarios work well, but brand-new game situations easily cause hesitation or mistakes.
sentences.note: 表达提示hesitation → 犹豫；game situation → 博弈局面；brand-new → 全新的

sentences.cn: （引用）原文依据：「一代主要还是在做场景到动作的一个映射，二代已经开始去理解场景到意图的这个过程，然后再做动作的一个推演。」
sentences.en: As the episode put it: 'Gen one mostly maps scenes to actions; gen two has started to understand the scene-to-intent process, then runs an action simulation.'
sentences.note: 表达提示scene-to-intent → 场景到意图；action simulation → 动作推演

sentences.cn: 核心机制：不只识别「这是不是路口」，还要判断「这个行人是要过马路还是站着等人」「那台电动车下一秒会不会横切」——预测意图和风险
sentences.en: The core mechanism: not just recognizing 'is this an intersection?' but judging 'is this pedestrian crossing or waiting?' 'will that scooter cut across next second?' — predicting intent and risk.
sentences.note: 表达提示cut across → 横切；predict intent → 预测意图；cross the road → 过马路

sentences.cn: 关键理解：世界模型驱动。即使没见过一模一样的场景，也能根据当前环境推测将来会发生什么，提前做防御性驾驶
sentences.en: The key insight: world-model-driven. Even without seeing an identical scene, it can infer what will happen next based on the current environment and drive defensively in advance.
sentences.note: 表达提示world model → 世界模型；defensive driving → 防御性驾驶；infer → 推测

scenes.title_cn: 三、硬件战争：垂直整合 vs 平台生态
scenes.title_en: The Hardware War: Vertical Integration vs. Platform Ecosystem
scenes.context: 小鹏三颗图灵芯片的垂直整合与英伟达开放平台的路线之争。语域：formal 芯片与商业战略。
scenes.speak: The core mechanism: three self-developed Turing chips, 2,250 Tops of total compute — above Nvidia Thor's flagship 2,000 Tops — plus 216 GB of large memory, fitting a full 30-billion-parameter model onto the vehicle for on-device running. The key insight: 50-100 milliseconds of inference latency — faster than a human's 'eyes see it to foot hits the brake.' Driving and music playback run as two systems on two brains, so they never interfere, avoiding mystery hard stops caused by resource conflicts. A typical scene: an accident up ahead on the highway; a round trip to the cloud taking half a second might already carry you tens of meters forward — on-device inference is a matter of life and death in distance. As the episode put it: XPeng's is actually a self-developed solution on its own mass-produced cars, with paper specs slightly higher than chip giant Nvidia's. Related concept: vertical integration thinking — full-chain self-development from bottom hardware to top software, performance squeezed to the extreme, but usable only by itself. Nvidia doesn't build cars; it offers an open 'physical AI' platform — the best stove, the sharpest knives, the freshest ingredients — letting BYD, Geely, and Nissan cook to their own taste. It suits global expansion, customizing driving styles per country's road conditions and regulations.

sentences.cn: 核心机制：三颗自研图灵芯片，总算力2250 Tops（英伟达Thor旗舰2000 Tops），配216GB大内存，将300亿参数大模型完整塞入车端本地运行
sentences.en: The core mechanism: three self-developed Turing chips, 2,250 Tops of total compute — above Nvidia Thor's flagship 2,000 Tops — plus 216 GB of large memory, fitting a full 30-billion-parameter model onto the vehicle for on-device running.
sentences.note: 表达提示compute → 算力；parameter model → 参数大模型；on-device running → 车端本地运行

sentences.cn: 关键理解：推理延迟50-100毫秒，比人类「眼睛看到→脚踩刹车」还快。开车和听歌两个系统两个大脑互不干扰，避免资源冲突导致莫名急刹
sentences.en: The key insight: 50-100 milliseconds of inference latency — faster than a human's 'eyes see it to foot hits the brake.' Driving and music playback run as two systems on two brains, so they never interfere, avoiding mystery hard stops caused by resource conflicts.
sentences.note: 表达提示inference latency → 推理延迟；hard stop → 急刹；resource conflict → 资源冲突

sentences.cn: 典型场景：高速上前方事故，云端往返半秒可能已冲出几十米——本地推理是生死距离
sentences.en: A typical scene: an accident up ahead on the highway; a round trip to the cloud taking half a second might already carry you tens of meters forward — on-device inference is a matter of life and death in distance.
sentences.note: 表达提示round trip to the cloud → 云端往返；a matter of life and death → 生死攸关

sentences.cn: （引用）原文依据：「小鹏其实是自研方案放在自己的量产车上，纸面参数比芯片巨头英伟达会稍微高一点。」
sentences.en: As the episode put it: 'XPeng's is actually a self-developed solution on its own mass-produced cars, with paper specs slightly higher than chip giant Nvidia's.'
sentences.note: 表达提示self-developed solution → 自研方案；paper specs → 纸面参数；mass-produced cars → 量产车

sentences.cn: （引用）相关概念：垂直整合思维——从底层硬件到上层软件全链路自研，性能榨到极致，但只能自己用
sentences.en: Related concept: vertical integration thinking — full-chain self-development from bottom hardware to top software, performance squeezed to the extreme, but usable only by itself.
sentences.note: 表达提示vertical integration → 垂直整合；full-chain → 全链路；squeeze to the extreme → 榨到极致

sentences.cn: 英伟达不造车，提供「物理AI」开放平台——最好的炉子、最锋利的刀具、最新鲜的食材，让比亚迪/吉利/日产等车企按自己口味「做菜」。适合全球化铺开，按各国路况法规定制驾驶风格
sentences.en: Nvidia doesn't build cars; it offers an open 'physical AI' platform — the best stove, the sharpest knives, the freshest ingredients — letting BYD, Geely, and Nissan cook to their own taste. It suits global expansion, customizing driving styles per country's road conditions and regulations.
sentences.note: 表达提示physical AI → 物理AI；cook to your taste → 按自己口味做菜；global expansion → 全球化铺开

scenes.title_en: The Software Soul: Two AI Personalities
scenes.context: 理想的世界模拟推演与小鹏的司机-分析师-批评家三人格。语域：formal 技术路线对比。
scenes.speak: Li Auto's approach, the core mechanism: the moment it sees a pedestrian, it instantly generates a dozen 3D animated storyboards of the next three seconds — stopping to check the phone, darting across suddenly, startled by a bicycle — assigns each a probability, and chooses the strategy that's safe under every possible future. The key insight: like a Go grandmaster thinking dozens of moves ahead before placing a stone. It builds an inferable 3D world with 3D Gaussian splatting, extremely compute-hungry and costly. The boundary: it's betting that 'exhaustively enumerating every possibility' is worth it — but the world always has unknown risks; you can never enumerate them all. As the episode put it: Li Auto is betting on a judgment about the future — it believes this trend is sound, and spending this much compute for a bit of extra safety redundancy is worth it. XPeng's approach, the core mechanism: a 40-billion-parameter VLA model with three personas working at once — the Driver (focusing on driving), the Analyst (recording the cause and effect of every imperfect move), and the Critic (scoring on safety, comfort, and smoothness). The key insight: failed cases are automatically prioritized into the next training round, forming a self-evolving loop. The iteration cycle can shrink to 12 hours — versus one week for traditional automakers.

sentences.cn: 核心机制：看到行人瞬间，立刻在脑中生成十几个未来3秒的3D动画短片（停下看手机/突然横穿/被自行车吓到），给每种分配概率，选择无论哪种未来都安全的策略
sentences.en: The core mechanism: the moment it sees a pedestrian, it instantly generates a dozen 3D animated storyboards of the next three seconds — stopping to check the phone, darting across suddenly, startled by a bicycle — assigns each a probability, and chooses the strategy that's safe under every possible future.
sentences.note: 表达提示storyboard → 分镜/动画短片；assign probability → 分配概率；safe under every future → 无论哪种未来都安全

sentences.cn: 关键理解：像下围棋高手落子前想十几步变化。用3D高斯溅射构建可被推演的三维世界，算力消耗极大、成本极高
sentences.en: The key insight: like a Go grandmaster thinking dozens of moves ahead before placing a stone. It builds an inferable 3D world with 3D Gaussian splatting, extremely compute-hungry and costly.
sentences.note: 表达提示Go grandmaster → 围棋高手；3D Gaussian splatting → 3D高斯溅射；compute-hungry → 算力消耗极大

sentences.cn: 适用边界：赌的是「穷举所有可能性」值得——但世界上永远有未知风险，不可能穷举
sentences.en: The boundary: it's betting that 'exhaustively enumerating every possibility' is worth it — but the world always has unknown risks; you can never enumerate them all.
sentences.note: 表达提示exhaustively enumerate → 穷举；unknown risk → 未知风险

sentences.cn: （引用）原文依据：「理想赌的是对未来的一个判断，他觉得这种趋势是靠谱的，将来用这么大的算力带来一点点安全冗余是值得的。」
sentences.en: As the episode put it: 'Li Auto is betting on a judgment about the future — it believes this trend is sound, and spending this much compute for a bit of extra safety redundancy is worth it.'
sentences.note: 表达提示bet on a judgment → 赌一个判断；safety redundancy → 安全冗余；worth it → 值得

sentences.cn: 核心机制：400亿参数VLA模型，三种人格同时工作：司机（专心开车）、分析师（记录每次不完美操作的因果）、批评家（从安全/舒适/流畅三维度打分）
sentences.en: The core mechanism: a 40-billion-parameter VLA model with three personas working at once — the Driver (focusing on driving), the Analyst (recording the cause and effect of every imperfect move), and the Critic (scoring on safety, comfort, and smoothness).
sentences.note: 表达提示persona → 人格；cause and effect → 因果；score on → 按…打分

sentences.cn: 关键理解：失败案例自动优先提取进入下一轮训练，形成自我进化闭环。迭代周期可缩短到12小时（传统车企一周）
sentences.en: The key insight: failed cases are automatically prioritized into the next training round, forming a self-evolving loop. The iteration cycle can shrink to 12 hours — versus one week for traditional automakers.
sentences.note: 表达提示self-evolving loop → 自我进化闭环；iteration cycle → 迭代周期；prioritize → 优先提取

scenes.title_cn: 五、信任重建：可解释性才是终极武器
scenes.title_en: Rebuilding Trust: Interpretability Is the Ultimate Weapon
scenes.context: 「哑巴开车」如何摧毁信任，以及二代VLA用语音解释操作。语域：formal 行业反思 + casual 场景描述。
scenes.speak: Why it matters: the past few years of autonomous driving accidents made a huge fuss, and the root cause is 'a mute driving' — after an accident, the car hands you hundreds of pages of logs and neural-network weight maps; ordinary people can't read them, and regulators are equally stumped. The boundary: explaining too often also gets annoying — talking to you every day on the commute — so you need a balance between transparency and interruption. As the episode put it: 'Because I observed a temporary road sign ahead, but the traffic light was covered by snow and unrecognizable, I therefore followed the hand signals of a police officer in uniform ahead and passed through slowly.' How to apply it: the gen-2 VLA can explain the reason for every maneuver in the car by voice — giving way because an ambulance is approaching from the rear right. Transparency matters more than any spec sheet. The reason: automakers hype endlessly, but the autonomous driving experience ultimately depends on real road conditions — and China's road game complexity is globally unique. The fix: on a test drive, proactively ask to hit complex traffic, observing prediction and intent understanding rather than demoing only on empty stretches.

sentences.cn: 为什么重要：过去几年智驾事故闹得沸沸扬扬，根本原因是「哑巴开车」——出了事给你看几百页日志和神经网络权重图，普通人看不懂，监管也头疼
sentences.en: Why it matters: the past few years of autonomous driving accidents made a huge fuss, and the root cause is 'a mute driving' — after an accident, the car hands you hundreds of pages of logs and neural-network weight maps; ordinary people can't read them, and regulators are equally stumped.
sentences.note: 表达提示make a fuss → 闹得沸沸扬扬；neural-network weights → 神经网络权重；regulator → 监管

sentences.cn: 适用边界：解释太频繁也会啰嗦（每天开车都在跟你讲话），需要平衡透明度与打扰度
sentences.en: The boundary: explaining too often also gets annoying — talking to you every day on the commute — so you need a balance between transparency and interruption.
sentences.note: 表达提示transparency → 透明度；interruption → 打扰；get annoying → 变得啰嗦

sentences.cn: （引用）"由于我观察到前方有临时路牌，但是信号灯被积雪覆盖无法识别，因此我是根据前方穿制服的交警他的手势引导，我是慢速通过的。"
sentences.en: As the episode put it: 'Because I observed a temporary road sign ahead, but the traffic light was covered by snow and unrecognizable, I therefore followed the hand signals of a police officer in uniform ahead and passed through slowly.'
sentences.note: 表达提示temporary road sign → 临时路牌；covered by snow → 被积雪覆盖；hand signals → 手势引导

sentences.cn: （引用）怎么落地：二代VLA能在车内用语音解释每一次操作的原因——右后方救护车接近所以让路。透明比任何参数都重要
sentences.en: How to apply it: the gen-2 VLA can explain the reason for every maneuver in the car by voice — giving way because an ambulance is approaching from the rear right. Transparency matters more than any spec sheet.
sentences.note: 表达提示explain by voice → 用语音解释；give way → 让路；spec sheet → 参数表

sentences.cn: 原因：车企吹得天花乱坠，但智驾体验最终取决于真实路况——中国道路的博弈复杂度全球独一无二
sentences.en: The reason: automakers hype endlessly, but the autonomous driving experience ultimately depends on real road conditions — and China's road game complexity is globally unique.
sentences.note: 表达提示hype → 吹嘘；real road conditions → 真实路况；globally unique → 全球独一无二

sentences.cn: 解法：试驾时主动要求走复杂路况，观察预判能力和意图理解，而非只在空旷路段演示
sentences.en: The fix: on a test drive, proactively ask to hit complex traffic, observing prediction and intent understanding rather than demoing only on empty stretches.
sentences.note: 表达提示test drive → 试驾；complex traffic → 复杂路况；empty stretch → 空旷路段

scenes.title_cn: 六、2026拐点：从交通工具到物理智能
scenes.title_en: The 2026 Inflection Point: From Vehicle to Physical Intelligence
scenes.context: VLA架构外溢到机器人，以及为何2026是拐点。语域：formal 行业展望 + casual 类比。
scenes.speak: The core mechanism: the VLA architecture isn't limited to cars — an AI system that can understand vision, use language, and take actions can do far more once you take it out of the car and drop it into a robot. XPeng builds both autonomous driving and humanoid robots, so the technology migrates seamlessly. The key insight: 2026 is a huge inflection point for autonomous driving — not just cars getting smarter, but cars learning to explain why they got smarter in language humans can understand. What we're witnessing isn't just a transportation revolution, but a general physical intelligence revolution. As the episode put it: whether you switch to a new car now or not, whether it has autonomous driving or not, you're starting to touch this thing — isn't it like seeing the iPhone for the first time, or the excitement of dial-up internet in the 80s? Related concept: Morgan Stanley points out that XPeng's gen-2 VLA gives it the ability to compete with Tesla globally — but the shift in the landscape goes far beyond cars, reaching embodied intelligence.

sentences.cn: 核心机制：VLA架构不限于汽车——能理解视觉、运用语言、做出行动的AI系统，从车里拿出来放到机器人里就能做更多事。小鹏同时做自动驾驶和人形机器人，技术可无缝迁移
sentences.en: The core mechanism: the VLA architecture isn't limited to cars — an AI system that can understand vision, use language, and take actions can do far more once you take it out of the car and drop it into a robot. XPeng builds both autonomous driving and humanoid robots, so the technology migrates seamlessly.
sentences.note: 表达提示humanoid robot → 人形机器人；seamless migration → 无缝迁移；drop into → 放入

sentences.cn: 关键理解：2026年是自动驾驶巨大拐点——不只是车变聪明，而是车学会用人类听得懂的方式解释自己为什么变聪明。见证的不是交通工具革命，而是通用物理智能革命
sentences.en: The key insight: 2026 is a huge inflection point for autonomous driving — not just cars getting smarter, but cars learning to explain why they got smarter in language humans can understand. What we're witnessing isn't just a transportation revolution, but a general physical intelligence revolution.
sentences.note: 表达提示inflection point → 拐点；transportation revolution → 交通工具革命；physical intelligence → 物理智能

sentences.cn: （引用）原文依据：「你现在换不换新的车、带不带智驾，其实你就开始接触这个东西了——像不像第一次看到iPhone，或80后用猫拨号上网那种兴奋。」
sentences.en: As the episode put it: 'Whether you switch to a new car now or not, whether it has autonomous driving or not, you're starting to touch this thing — isn't it like seeing the iPhone for the first time, or the excitement of dial-up internet in the 80s?'
sentences.note: 表达提示touch this thing → 接触这个东西；dial-up internet → 拨号上网；excitement → 兴奋

sentences.cn: （引用）相关概念：摩根士丹利指出小鹏二代VLA落地使其具备与特斯拉全球竞争能力，但格局变化远不止汽车，还包括具身智能
sentences.en: Related concept: Morgan Stanley points out that XPeng's gen-2 VLA gives it the ability to compete with Tesla globally — but the shift in the landscape goes far beyond cars, reaching embodied intelligence.
sentences.note: 表达提示Morgan Stanley → 摩根士丹利；embodied intelligence → 具身智能；shift the landscape → 改变格局

practice.cn: 用「sensing ≠ understanding」说：看到不等于理解。
practice.en: Sensing isn't understanding — the car sees the road but must also grasp intent.

practice.cn: 用「world model」说：二代VLA靠世界模型预判。
practice.en: The gen-2 VLA is world-model-driven — it infers the future from the current scene.

practice.cn: 用「on-device inference」说：本地推理是生死距离。
practice.en: On-device inference is a matter of life and death — cloud round trips waste a life-saving half second.

practice.cn: 用「interpretability」说：可解释性重建信任。
practice.en: Interpretability rebuilds trust — the car tells you why it braked, in plain language.

pitfalls.wrong: The VLA model can see and do things.
pitfalls.right: The VLA model fuses seeing, language understanding, and action into one pipeline.
pitfalls.why: see and do 太笼统；fuse…into one 体现三合一机制。

pitfalls.wrong: XPeng's chip is more strong than Nvidia.
pitfalls.right: XPeng's three Turing chips reach 2,250 Tops, slightly above Nvidia Thor's flagship.
pitfalls.why: more strong 语法错误；用数字说话更有说服力。

pitfalls.wrong: The car can speak the reason.
pitfalls.right: The gen-2 VLA can explain every maneuver in voice.
pitfalls.why: speak the reason 是中式表达；explain every maneuver 才是完整说法。

pitfalls.wrong: Li Auto thinks a lot of possibilities.
pitfalls.right: Li Auto enumerates possible futures — a dozen storyboards with assigned probabilities.
pitfalls.why: think a lot 太随意；enumerate + assign probabilities 是技术准确的说法。
